goal: Understand how stella is architected - model serving, pipeline, context management, and core agent loop - so a self-improving model playbook can reference real components

## stella-pipeline/src/lib.rs
    1  // SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
    2  // Copyright (c) 2026 Oxagen, Inc. Commercial licensing: licensing@oxagen.sh
    3  
    4  //! `stella-pipeline` — the orchestration plane that sits *above*
    5  //! `stella-core::Engine`. It drives one prompt
    6  //! through the staged turn flow — **evaluate → enhance → route → execute →
    7  //! witness → verify → judge → revise** (the witness is authored on demand,
    8  //! after execution, once the warrant has read the diff) — over injected
    9  //! ports, emitting an `AgentEvent` at every stage boundary.
